text:
Type: glass-door bookcase wall
Use: storing and displaying books, collections and china; living room, home office, home library, dining room
Style: Scandinavian, classic, traditional
Materials: birch wood veneer, framed glass-panel doors, small metal knobs
Colors: light natural birch, clear glass
Shape: wide floor-to-ceiling run of five sections, four behind tall glass doors with glass top cabinets, an open center column of shelves, flat top, plinth base, large and substantial
Feel: orderly, bright, scholarly, calm
Goes with: white walls, light wood floors, reading chairs, warm lighting; Scandinavian or classic living rooms, home libraries

product.name: BILLY,OXBERG
product.description: Adjustable shelves, so you can customise your storage as needed.
